# LeadGrid — Data Handling Notes

## What we collect
Our crawler visits public company pages, LinkedIn profiles and conference
attendee listings and extracts: full name, job title, employer, work email
where shown, personal email where shown, phone number, city, and a free-text
"about" blurb. Records are keyed by email address. Individuals are not
contacted before or after collection and no notice is served to them.

## Retention
Every record collected is kept in the primary database for the lifetime of the
product. There is no deletion job. Superseded versions of a record are kept as
history rows so customers can see how a contact's role changed over time.
Nightly snapshots go to S3 and are also kept permanently.

## Access and export
Customers can export any segment to CSV without limit. Exports are not logged
per-record. Two engineers hold read access to the raw crawl tables via a
shared `analyst` database account.

## Requests from individuals
We have received four emails asking us to remove a record. There is no
documented workflow; the on-call engineer deletes the row manually if they get
to it. We do not track whether the record reappears on the next crawl.

## Transfers
The database runs in eu-central-1. The enrichment step calls a US vendor
(ClearScope Inc.) with name + employer + email to fetch firmographics. There
is no contract with ClearScope beyond clicking through their online signup.
